title: All Saints' Church, Nottingham
geometryBasis: OSM way 217477393 identifies the listed church by its name, Wikidata item and address. The mapped ring fixes the orientation, overall exterior outline, buttresses and apsidal termination.
sectionBasis: National Heritage List notes identify the clerestory, aisles, three-stage west tower, two tiers of lucarnes, apsidal chancel, transept rose windows and subsidiary turrets. The parish history and the contemporary Imperial Gazetteer put the steeple at 175 feet. The cleared Qualla view identifies the stone bands and general roof colors.
limitations: The model represents the listed church. The independently listed school, vicarage, community centre, gates and railings remain outside its scope.

The rock-faced sandstone massing follows the mapped footprint. The nominal 53.34 metre spire follows the 175-foot parish and Victorian gazetteer accounts. A 1924 local source gives 154 feet, and the height has not been independently surveyed.
Approximate upper wall heights, isometric roof junctions, stone band spacing and tracery represent the documented exterior at medium fidelity.
